def test_remap_palette_rgba_transparency(self):
        # An RGBA palette together with a transparency index: remapping keeps
        # the RGBA entries and moves the transparency index with its entry
        im = Image.new("P", (2, 1))
        im.putpixel((1, 0), 1)
        im.putpalette((10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80), "RGBA")
        im.info["transparency"] = 0

        im_same = im.remap_palette([0, 1])
        assert list(im_same.getdata()) == [0, 1]
        assert bytes(im_same.palette.palette[:8]) == bytes(
            (10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80)
        )
        assert im_same.info["transparency"] == 0

        im_remapped = im.remap_palette([1, 0])
        assert list(im_remapped.getdata()) == [1, 0]
        assert bytes(im_remapped.palette.palette[:8]) == bytes(
            (50, 60, 70, 80, 10, 20, 30, 40)
        )
        assert im_remapped.info["transparency"] == 1
        # The transparency index renders fully transparent, the other entry
        # keeps its own alpha
        assert list(im_remapped.convert("RGBA").getdata()) == [
            (10, 20, 30, 0),
            (50, 60, 70, 80),
        ]

        # The same with a full 256-entry RGBA palette
        im = Image.new("P", (256, 1))
        for x in range(256):
            im.putpixel((x, 0), x)
        im.putpalette(list(range(256)) * 4, "RGBA")
        im.info["transparency"] = 0
        palette_before = bytes(im.palette.palette)

        im_same = im.remap_palette(list(range(256)))
        assert bytes(im_same.palette.palette[:1024]) == palette_before[:1024]
        assert im_same.info["transparency"] == 0

        im_remapped = im.remap_palette([1, 0] + list(range(2, 256)))
        assert bytes(im_remapped.palette.palette[:8]) == (
            palette_before[4:8] + palette_before[:4]
        )
        assert im_remapped.info["transparency"] == 1
